column1: # Zalo webhook allowlist: one customer per line.
#   - senderUid or conversationId may be empty
#   - A message is reported when its sender UID OR its conversation id matches a line.
#   - Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored; malformed lines are skipped (warn).
#   - Re-read automatically when the file changes (within ~30 s); no restart needed.
#   - Missing/unreadable/no valid line => NO webhook is sent (fail closed).
